environment: Node VM with minimal DOM stub; this is logic verification, not rendered browser QA
checks: Chart contains fourteen exact source observations
Ingredient reconciliation equals 3.5 mg for two fictional labels
Exposure dates use the record timezone near UTC midnight
Planned, skipped and tombstoned intakes are excluded
Unverified product or ingredient labels suppress daily totals
Unsupported unit suppresses partial total with a reason
Whitelisted mass conversion is exact before summation
Tombstoned labels are excluded and incomplete totals remain unavailable
New record preserves zero, missingness, provenance and revision
Same-date update retains UUID and increments revision
Missing observation produces a chart gap
No external resources, network API or persistent browser storage
Keyboard, input labels and status semantics present; no rendered claim
Caffeine form boundary matches canonical maximum
browser_verification: blocked: local Chromium could not open sockets in this environment
limitations: CSV download execution and actual browser form validation require Chromium test
